crossRefs.note: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.
Yes, he scoffs at kings, and princes are a derision to him. He laughs at every stronghold, for he builds up an earthen…

translations.web: The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.
translations.bsb: No arrow can make him flee; slingstones become like chaff to him.
translations.kjv: The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
translations.asv: The arrow cannot make him flee: Sling-stones are turned with him into stubble.
